turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes, we can practise this today.

You already know sentences like "I work" in the present simple. Today's goal: use the right verb form after he, she and it when you talk about work routines.

Here is a model: "My colleague answers the phone every morning."

Your task: write two sentences about the daily routine of a colleague or a friend. Use "he" or "she" in at least one sentence. I will give feedback on your verbs.
